calculation.description: Cross-sectional one-day reversal normalized by each asset's trailing 20-session volatility, amplified when cross-asset 20-session return dispersion is high. Every input is lagged so the signal uses only the prior completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Passed benchmark daily IC and ICIR gates, but the recoverable valid-signal sample contains only 101 dates concentrated in 2026; uncertainty is high and the low raw artifact coverage reflects warmup/missing rolling values. Five-day IC/ICIR were 0.0200155/0.0785368 and ten-day IC/ICIR were 0.04479698/0.18769675.
